001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.operation.Operation;
005import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import java.util.Deque;
010import java.util.List;
011
012public interface InventoryTransaction {
013
014  /**
015   * Commit the transaction
016   *
017   * @return The transaction success.
018   */
019  boolean commit();
020
021  /**
022   * Commit the transaction with callback
023   *
024   * @param callback The result callback
025   *
026   * @return The transaction success.
027   */
028  boolean commit(@NotNull InventoryTransaction.TransactionCallback callback);
029
030  /**
031   * Commit the transaction by the Fail-Safe way Automatic rollback when commit failed
032   *
033   * @return The transaction success.
034   */
035  boolean failSafeCommit();
036
037  int getAmount();
038
039  void setAmount(int amount);
040
041  @Nullable
042  InventoryWrapper getFrom();
043
044  void setFrom(@NotNull InventoryWrapper from);
045
046  @NotNull
047  ItemStack getItem();
048
049  void setItem(@NotNull ItemStack item);
050
051  @Nullable
052  String getLastError();
053
054  void setLastError(@Nullable String lastError);
055
056  @NotNull
057  Deque<Operation> getProcessingStack();
058
059  @Nullable
060  InventoryWrapper getTo();
061
062  void setTo(@Nullable InventoryWrapper to);
063
064  /**
065   * Rolling back the transaction
066   *
067   * @param continueWhenFailed Continue when some parts of the rollback fails.
068   *
069   * @return A list contains all steps executed. If "continueWhenFailed" is false, it only contains
070   * all success steps before hit the error. Else all.
071   */
072  @SuppressWarnings("UnusedReturnValue")
073  @NotNull
074  List<Operation> rollback(boolean continueWhenFailed);
075
076  interface TransactionCallback {
077
078    /**
079     * Calling while Transaction commit
080     *
081     * @param transaction Transaction
082     *
083     * @return Does commit event has been cancelled
084     */
085    default boolean onCommit(@NotNull final InventoryTransaction transaction) {
086
087      return true;
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Calling while Transaction commit failed Use InventoryTransaction#getLastError() to getting
092     * reason Use InventoryTransaction#getSteps() to getting the fail step
093     *
094     * @param transaction Transaction
095     */
096    default void onFailed(@NotNull final InventoryTransaction transaction) {
097
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Calling while Transaction commit successfully
102     *
103     * @param transaction Transaction
104     */
105    default void onSuccess(@NotNull final InventoryTransaction transaction) {
106
107    }
108
109  }
110}
